function healthNode(owner, id, fields) {
  const { failureReason, error, sources } = fields;
  return cachedNode(owner, id ?? fields.alias, {
    ...fields,
    hasErrors: failureReason !== null || error !== null || sources.some((child) => child.hasErrors)
  });
};
function findProblems(health) {
  if (!health.hasErrors) return [];
  const ownProblem = health.failureReason !== null || health.error !== null;
  return [
    ...ownProblem ? [health] : [],
    ...health.sources.flatMap(findProblems)
  ];
};
function cachedNode(owner, key, next) {
  let nodes = nodeCache.get(owner);
  if (!nodes) nodeCache.set(owner, nodes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map());
  const previous = nodes.get(key);
  if (previous && sameNode(previous, next)) return previous;
  nodes.set(key, next);
  return next;
}
function sameNode(a, b) {
  return a.collectionId === b.collectionId && a.kind === b.kind && a.status === b.status && a.hasErrors === b.hasErrors && a.failureReason === b.failureReason && a.error === b.error && a.reloading === b.reloading && a.sources.length === b.sources.length && a.sources.every((source, index) => source === b.sources[index]);
}
